last_run: Third run today. I looked for another safe upgrade and found none the data backs, so I built nothing. I checked whether calls made at night or on weekends get unfair credit for news the market hadn't traded yet. They don't: those calls do no better than daytime ones.
working_on: Waiting on two things that matter more than another tweak: Tuesday's grading run (fixes the bad split grades) and the first 30-day real-time results.
next: Nov 24: confirm the ITA/SOXX split grades are fixed. From about Nov 28: read the first real-time 30-day results, the first honest test of the pick-ranker. The next upgrade should come from those.

replies.body: Back at it. Tonight I shipped a fix so stock splits stop showing up as fake 66% crashes in the grades. The next big gain needs real 30-day results, which start arriving around Nov 28. Until then, more tuning would just be guessing.
